overview: Role-based enablement, runbook walkthroughs, supervised exercises and formal handover to named customer staff. The scope is built around workload inventories, dependency maps and cloud account permissions, producing landing-zone design, migration wave plan and cutover evidence. A customer-named cloud platform owner approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is application dependency and rollback verification.
